subject: BlueHarbor security readiness summary & action plan
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: BlueHarbor security readiness summary & action plan

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call + proposed next steps so we can align with your InfoSec and procurement teams. Please let me know if I missed anything.

High-level pain & goals you shared:
- You need a vendor with a Type II SOC 2 report and demonstrable controls around audit logs and access reviews.
- Retention policy flexibility: primary ask is 13 months of immutable audit logs for transaction traces across environments.
- DPA redlines are likely (data residency + subprocessor list); procurement will want a countersigned DPA before production.
- Pen test evidence: you need a redacted executive summary plus confirmation of remediation for high/critical findings.

What Redwood will provide (today):
- Attached: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026_redacted.pdf (control-oriented summary, scope: hosting + processing).
- Attached: audit-log-sample-2026.csv — sample events export showing user, action, timestamp, IP, request_id.
- Attached: pen-test-summary-2026-redacted.pdf — executive summary and remediation tracker.
- Initial DPA template: DPA_Redwood_BlueHarbor_v1.docx (for your redlines).

Proposed next steps & owners:
1) Share documents with BlueHarbor InfoSec and procurement (Karthik) — within 24 hours.
2) Marissa to confirm technical details on log export formats, retention TTLs and namespaces; provide a short how-to for on-prem S3 archiving option — by 2026-11-16 EOD.
3) Ben (Solutions) to scope any additional pen-test artifacts we can share beyond the redacted summary (e.g., remediation evidence) — by 2026-11-17.
4) If procurement wants to proceed, we’ll exchange a DPA and target countersignature within 2 business days after the initial redlines are received.

Quick ask for you: please confirm the primary security contact (InfoSec) and procurement lead we should share the pack with so we can send links and a DocuSign flow.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026_redacted.pdf (pdf), audit-log-sample-2026.csv (csv), DPA_Redwood_BlueHarbor_v1.docx (docx), pen-test-summary-2026-redacted.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

--

From: Sara Connors <sara.connors@blueharbor.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 18:23:12 -0800
Subject: Re: BlueHarbor security readiness summary & action plan

Karthik —

Appreciate the clear recap and the documents. I shared the SOC2 and pen-test summary with our InfoSec lead (cc'd: procurement@blueharbor.com). A couple of clarifying questions from the review:

1) SOC2: can you confirm the date range for the Type II report and whether the scope includes your multi-tenant hosted runtime + dedicated instances? We need clear language for procurement.
2) Audit logs: the sample looks good — can Redwood support an immutable export to our S3 (us-east-1) with server-side encryption and a 13-month retention TTL? Also: do logs include anonymized user IDs or full PII? We need to avoid logging customer PII.
3) Pen test: we can accept a redacted summary but procurement may ask for the CVSS scores for high findings. Is that something you can provide in a redacted table?

Procurement note: our contract team will push back on some DPA clauses (notably subprocessor termination notice & data residency). Please route any DPA redlines to procurement@blueharbor.com and copy me.

Primary contacts:
- InfoSec: Michael Tran <michael.tran@blueharbor.com>
- Procurement: procurement@blueharbor.com (team inbox)

If you can respond with the SOC2 date range and a brief note on log PII handling today, we can have a short follow-up call mid-week.

Thanks,
Sara
Director, Product Ops | BlueHarbor Finance

Hi Sara —

Looping in technical details per Karthik's note and your questions. Short answers + where to find more: 

1) SOC2 scope & date range:
- Report period: 2026-01-01 through 2026-09-30 (Type II). Scope includes Hosted API and Dedicated pools (we have an appendix listing exclusions). See page 3 of the attached SOC2 PDF for scope language.

2) Audit logs & retention:
- We support streaming audit exports to customer-owned S3 buckets in us-east-1 with SSE-KMS. We can configure an append-only lifecycle plus object lock for the retention period.
- Default log schema (included in audit-log-sample-2026.csv) contains: timestamp, actor_id (internal user/email), actor_role, action, resource_id, request_id, source_ip. We do not log raw customer PII fields by default — application payloads are excluded from standard audit exports. If you need additional redaction rules, we can apply a pre-processor to mask fields.

3) Pen test details:
- We can provide a redacted findings table with CVSS scores for high/critical findings; we keep full raw reports under NDA and typically share them with an SoW or procurement NDA. The redacted table will include: finding id, impact summary, CVSS score (redacted to numeric only), and remediation status.

4) DPA redlines workflow:
- Please send redlines to procurement@blueharbor.com; we'll coordinate with legal and aim for a countersign within 48 business hours after receiving redlines. DocuSign link will be generated once redlines are accepted for signature (we will post it to the shared Drive link).

Internal action items (owners & ETA):
- Marissa: Provide S3 export how-to and object-lock configuration doc — due 2026-11-16 EOD. (attached link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/BlueHarbor/SecurityPack)
- Ben: Prepare redacted CVSS table + note on what we can share under the standard confidentiality agreement — due 2026-11-17 COB.
- Karthik: Follow up with procurement to request any DPA redlines and schedule a legal intro call if needed — ongoing.

If it helps, happy to set a 30-minute technical sync with Michael Tran and one of our security engineers this week. Availability: Tue/Wed 10–12 PST.

Thanks —
Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
